changes: 🎰 Live Blackjack: real hand-dealing logic, server side. Full deck build/shuffle, hand-value calculation, dealer AI (stands on any 17, matching the app's own existing reference text elsewhere), and payout settlement (blackjack pays 3:2, regular win 1:1, push returns the bet). Five new actions: setBet, dealHand, hit, stand, double.

Solo-friendly by design: only seats with a bet currently staged get dealt into a hand. Sit down and bet alone — dealing plays out immediately against just the dealer. Anyone who sits down without betting simply watches until the next round, rather than being pulled into a hand already in progress.

Dealer's hole card is genuinely hidden until reveal — the full dealer hand and remaining deck live in a new /blackjackTableSecrets path, set to .read:false for everyone (server included, only reachable via this function's own authenticated calls), same security posture Hold'em uses for its own hidden hand data.
Server foundation only this pass — the client UI (showing cards, whose turn it is, hit/stand/double buttons) is the deliberate next step, not part of this one.
